questions.answer: Gross NPA ratio was 4.67% at Jan 2026 (-0.46 pp vs last month). -1.19 pp vs previous quarter. -1.14 pp vs last year. Main driver: Closed / exited: −₹19.11 Cr (5 accounts), more than the whole net NPA outstanding movement (310%); other flows partly offset it.

findings.text: Gross NPA ratio fell 0.46 pp vs last month to 4.67%.
DEMO-NORTH (branch) accounted for 98% of the change in Gross NPA ratio vs last month.
Closed / exited: −₹19.11 Cr (5 accounts), more than the whole net NPA outstanding movement (310%); other flows partly offset it.
By ticket size, the change is driven by rate (segments got worse or better): rate -0.44 pp, mix -0.02 pp.

caveats: NPA status is the lender's flag; reasons for slippage (borrower, economic) are not in the data.
Write-offs and closures reduce NPA mechanically.

questions.question: Are accounts slipping into later buckets faster?
questions.answer: No forward roll rate is materially above its 12-month average in Jan 2026. Key rates: Current → 1-30 DPD 1% (avg 1%); 61-90 DPD → 90+ DPD 100% (avg 75%).
caveats: Roll rates are month-on-month account transitions; small buckets make rates volatile.
